note: Asking prices in euros from the original listing on the day each home was added. Medians describe the homes RealHunt lists (cheap for their country, checked by a person), not a country's whole market. Rules, taxes and costs are general information, not legal or tax advice.
sentences: On 24 November 2026, RealHunt lists 18 homes for sale in the Netherlands, each one checked by a person.
In the Netherlands, the median asking price of those 18 homes is €325,000 (€4,286 per m², from the 18 homes with a known size); the cheapest costs €299,000 and the most expensive €339,500.
Taxes and fees add about 2–9% to the price of a home in the Netherlands (figures as of 2026).

buying.costs_breakdown: Transfer tax (overdrachtsbelasting) of 8% if you will not live in the home, such as a buy-to-let or holiday home, or 2% if it becomes your main home; a notary fee for the transfer deed of around EUR 500; Kadaster registration fees; and mortgage costs if you borrow; the seller pays its own agent.
buying.can_foreigners_buy: Yes. There are no nationality or residence rules and no surcharge for foreign buyers. Some cities, such as The Hague, restrict renting out cheaper homes after purchase without a permit (opkoopbescherming).
buying.annual_property_tax: Owners pay municipal property tax (onroerendezaakbelasting, OZB) on the official WOZ value, at a rate each municipality sets, which in practice is a per mille figure; tenants of homes do not pay it.
buying.rental_income_tax: Non-residents declare Dutch property in box 3, where tax is 36% on a deemed return of 6% of the property's value in 2026, after a tax-free allowance of EUR 59,357 per person, regardless of actual rent.

homes.title: Remodelled corner flat with a south balcony over the canal, Reigersbos
homes.title_es: Piso esquinero remodelado con balcón al sur sobre el canal, Reigersbos
homes.summary: 72 m² on the 1st floor: the layout was redone so the bedrooms face the front and the living room the back, with a modern dark kitchen, a new shower room with washer and dryer, and a green south balcony over the water. Energy label B, leasehold bought off for good, service charge about €234 a month. Asking €299,000 k.k. (buyer pays transfer costs), about €4,096/m².

homes.title: 107 m² corner flat on the 10th floor with views over nature, Amsterdam
homes.title_es: Piso esquinero de 107 m² en la planta 10 con vistas a la naturaleza, Ámsterdam
homes.summary: A huge 107 m² corner flat (formerly four rooms) on the 10th floor of the Gouden Rand in Zuidoost: a long bright living room with an open kitchen, two bedrooms, a bathroom and a balcony over the treetops. Lift and closed entrance; metro and A1/A2/A10 nearby, about 10 minutes by car to the centre. Leasehold (erfpacht), service charge about €485 a month. Asking €325,000 k.k. (buyer pays transfer costs), about €3,037/m².

homes.title: Three-room flat with a 14 m² south terrace next to Reigersbos metro
homes.title_es: Piso de tres habitaciones con terraza de 14 m² al sur junto al metro Reigersbos
homes.summary: 72 m² on the 1st floor, 50 m from Reigersbos shopping centre and metro: a big living room with an open kitchen, two bedrooms and a 14 m² south-facing terrace. Ample parking; insulation upgrade planned for 2028; leasehold fixed on good terms. Asking €299,000 k.k. (buyer pays transfer costs), about €4,153/m².

homes.title: Top-floor flat under the eaves with skylights near the Gaasperplas
homes.title_es: Ático bajo cubierta con ventanas de tejado junto al lago Gaasperplas
homes.summary: 72 m² (122 m² gross) on the top floor of a well-kept building in Gein: a very bright living room under skylights, an open white kitchen, two bedrooms and a bathroom with a bath. Room to add a dormer; leasehold bought off for good. Asking €300,000 k.k. (buyer pays transfer costs), about €4,167/m².

homes.title: 93 m² four-room flat with a 13.5 m² balcony by Nelson Mandela Park
homes.title_es: Piso de cuatro habitaciones y 93 m² con balcón de 13,5 m² junto al parque Nelson Mandela
homes.summary: 93 m² on the 7th floor with a lift near Nelson Mandela Park: a large living and dining room with big windows, three bedrooms and a 13.5 m² balcony along the whole side with open views over the green. Leasehold bought off for good (eeuwigdurend afgekocht). Asking €335,000 k.k. (buyer pays transfer costs), about €3,602/m².

homes.title: Top-floor four-room flat with energy label A and green views, Gein
homes.title_es: Ático de cuatro habitaciones con etiqueta energética A y vistas verdes, Gein
homes.summary: 70 m² on the top floor with no upstairs neighbours: a big living room with an open white kitchen, three bedrooms, a renewed bathroom, lots of storage and a balcony over the green. 2023 boiler, energy label A, leasehold bought off for good. Asking €305,000 k.k. (buyer pays transfer costs), about €4,357/m².

homes.title: 80 m² three-bedroom flat with a lift and balcony on Plein 40-45
homes.title_es: Piso de tres dormitorios y 80 m² con ascensor y balcón en Plein 40-45
homes.summary: 80.5 m² on the 3rd floor with a lift in Nieuw-West: a through living room with big windows, three bedrooms, a kitchen, a bathroom, a storeroom and a large balcony looking over Plein 40-45. Quick handover possible. Asking €330,000 k.k. (buyer pays transfer costs), about €4,074/m².

homes.title: Top-floor corner flat with three bedrooms in Venserpolder
homes.title_es: Ático esquinero con tres dormitorios en Venserpolder
homes.summary: 75 m² on the top floor, corner position with big windows: a bright living room, a white country-style kitchen, three bedrooms and a storeroom downstairs. Well kept, leasehold bought off for good; Amsterdamse Poort shops and metro nearby. Asking €315,000 k.k. (buyer pays transfer costs), about €4,200/m².

homes.title: Three-room flat with a 15 m² south balcony and free views in Nellestein
homes.title_es: Piso de tres habitaciones con balcón de 15 m² al sur y vistas libres en Nellestein
homes.summary: 75 m² with a new white kitchen, wood-look floors and a 15 m² south balcony looking over nature, on a car-free street with a cycle path. Amstel station 13 minutes by public transport; leasehold bought off for good. Asking €325,000 k.k. (buyer pays transfer costs), about €4,333/m².

homes.title: Three-room flat with a sunny roof terrace by Reigersbos market
homes.title_es: Piso de tres habitaciones con terraza soleada junto al mercado de Reigersbos
homes.summary: 71 m² on the 1st floor: a large living room with a dining area, two bedrooms, a kitchen and a south-east roof terrace for the morning sun. In the middle of Reigersbos shopping centre (Wednesday market), metro at the door; leasehold bought off for good. Asking €310,000 k.k. (buyer pays transfer costs), about €4,366/m².

homes.title: Bright three-room flat with two balconies in Venserpolder
homes.title_es: Piso luminoso de tres habitaciones con dos balcones en Venserpolder
homes.summary: 70 m² on the 2nd floor: a bright through living room, two full bedrooms, a kitchen, two balconies and a storeroom. Leasehold bought off for good; Amsterdamse Poort, Nelson Mandela Park and the metro all close. Asking €310,000 k.k. (buyer pays transfer costs), about €4,429/m².

homes.title: Ground-floor flat with tropical front and back gardens in Gein
homes.title_es: Piso en planta baja con jardines tropicales delante y detrás en Gein
homes.summary: 73 m² ground-floor home with two bedrooms, a bright living room with a dining area and two tropical gardens with palms, banana plants and a covered tiki-style terrace. Quiet green street, Gein metro a short walk; leasehold bought off for good, service charge €173 a month. Asking €325,000 k.k. (buyer pays transfer costs), about €4,452/m².

homes.title: 79 m² flat with an 11 m² balcony and open views in Amsterdam-Noord
homes.title_es: Piso de 79 m² con balcón de 11 m² y vistas abiertas en Ámsterdam-Noord
homes.summary: 79 m² high up in the green Molenwijk, with a lift: a big living room with a half-open kitchen, two large bedrooms, a bathroom, a separate WC, a private storeroom and an 11 m² balcony across the whole width with open views. Asking €335,000 k.k. (buyer pays transfer costs), about €4,241/m².

homes.title: Four-room flat with energy label A and a south balcony in Zuidoost
homes.title_es: Piso de cuatro habitaciones con etiqueta energética A y balcón al sur en Zuidoost
homes.summary: 77 m² on the 2nd floor: a bright living room with a 7 m² south balcony, a kitchen, three bedrooms, a bathroom and a 7 m² storeroom downstairs. Energy label A; service charge €225 a month. Asking €330,000 k.k. (buyer pays transfer costs), about €4,286/m².

homes.title: Five-room flat with four bedrooms in Amsterdam Zuidoost
homes.title_es: Piso de cinco estancias con cuatro dormitorios en Ámsterdam Zuidoost
homes.summary: 82 m² with four bedrooms, a bright living room, a white kitchen, a bathroom and new laminate floors throughout. Leasehold bought off for good and an active owners' association (€221 a month). Rare at this price for a family. Asking €339,500 k.k. (buyer pays transfer costs), about €4,140/m².

homes.title: Three-room flat with energy label A and a south balcony over the water
homes.title_es: Piso de tres habitaciones con etiqueta energética A y balcón al sur sobre el agua
homes.summary: 70 m² on the 6th floor of Grubbehoeve: a big living room, a new white kitchen, two full bedrooms and a 10 m² south balcony looking over greenery, water and the Zuidoost skyline. Energy label A, leasehold bought off for good, Ganzenhoef metro a short walk. Asking €315,000 k.k. (buyer pays transfer costs), about €4,500/m².

homes.title: 12th-floor flat with sweeping views and a covered balcony, Nieuw-West
homes.title_es: Piso en la planta 12 con vistas panorámicas y balcón cubierto, Nieuw-West
homes.summary: 71 m² on the 12th floor: a long living room, a bedroom opening onto the covered balcony, an extra room fitted as a walk-in closet and a private storeroom. Big windows with views over the city; leasehold bought off. Asking €325,000 k.k. (buyer pays transfer costs), about €4,514/m².

homes.title: Three-room flat with a modern kitchen and two balconies in Reigersbos
homes.title_es: Piso de tres habitaciones con cocina moderna y dos balcones en Reigersbos
homes.summary: 74 m² on the 3rd floor: a bright living room, a modern white kitchen with an induction hob, two bedrooms, a new bathroom and WC, a 5 m² west balcony plus a small back balcony and a storeroom. Energy label C, leasehold bought off; the buyer must live in it (self-occupancy rule). Asking €330,000 k.k. (buyer pays transfer costs), about €4,459/m².
